data.name: Zagara

abilities.name: Commander
abilities.text: Treat this Unit's Supply characteristic as increased by 1 for Controlling and Contesting Mission Markers, completing objectives, and resolving Disengage checks.

abilities.name: Transfusion
abilities.text: Use when another Friendly Biological Unit (including a Structure) suffers Damage Within 4″. Reduce the Total Damage before allocation by 2.

abilities.name: Psionic Link
abilities.text: Once per Round, if there are at least 7 Friendly models Within 6″ of this Unit, it may resolve its Special Ability with the BM cost reduced by 1.

abilities.name: Infested Drop
abilities.text: The base of the Zagara counts as an Entry Edge. Each Round, Friendly Units with a combined Supply cost of 1 may be Deployed via this Entry Edge.

abilities.name: Indomitable
abilities.text: While Engaged, this Unit may target and be targeted by Unengaged Enemy Units. In both cases, the defending Unit gains an Evade Roll against those attacks.

abilities.name: Devastating Charge
abilities.text: Immediately after this Unit completes a successful Charge, resolve the IMPACT (6) 3+ effect.

upgrades.name: Broodmother
upgrades.text: Apply one of the following effects to all Friendly units (Line of Sight is not required). You cannot apply the effect chosen in the previous Game Round: Units of Size 1 gain a +1 Modifier to all IMPACT Rolls. All weapons of Size 2 Units gain CRITICAL HIT (1). Units of Size 3 or more gain TOUGH (1).

data.note: Broodmother is printed as an Upgrade, but the 10.2026 cost table lists no cost for it, so the app charges 0. Check for a later cost table.
